unmeasured: Running duration of the menu, tooltip and dialog keyframes: the keyframes are recorded, but they were not running when measured. Use the 0.16s control duration for tooltips and 0.25s for panels.
The hero product window plays a scripted sequence (typing, a moving cursor, rows changing). It is driven by script and is not specified here.
A decorative dot grid moves each dot up and down on a 2.8s linear infinite loop.
Search pill open state on the changelog and integrations pages: the search was not opened, so its panel and motion are not observed.
Scroll-linked highlight of the current category in the integrations side list: not observed; only the static current state was measured.
Logo marquee pause on hover: not observed.

principles: Paint everything on #08090a. Separate regions with 1px #23252a hairlines and faint white overlays, never with card backgrounds plus drop shadows.
Build hierarchy from the four text greys before reaching for size: #f7f8f8, #d0d6e0, #8a8f98, #62666d.
Use weight 510 for emphasis and 590 for the strongest labels. Do not use 600 or 700.
Interface text is 13px, body is 15px. Large type is reserved for one headline per section.
Align to the left edge of the column. Put the headline in the left half and its paragraph in the right half.
Every control is a pill. One light primary button per view; all other actions use the overlay fill or plain text.
Colour is information, not decoration: indigo for selection, green, red and blue for status.
Show the real product interface as the imagery, inside a 12px-radius panel with a 1px edge.
avoid: Cards with visible drop shadows on the canvas
Decorative icons, emoji and illustration that is not product interface

templates.name: Docs
templates.use: Documentation and developer home: an app shell instead of the marketing chrome.
structure: Sidebar: fixed, 280px wide, full height, 1px #23252a right line; a 64px top bar with logo, a 1px divider, 'Docs' and a 32px round search button; grouped links (12px/16.8px 510 #8a8f98 group label 28px tall, 32px rows with a 16px icon and 13px label) in a scroll area that fades out at the bottom; four 36px area links (Docs, Developers, Learn, Contact support) pinned at the bottom under a 1px line.
Top bar: 64px with a 1px line, breadcrumb 14px/510 on the left, theme icon button and a 32px Sign up pill on the right.
Content: 976px column, 48px top padding, h1 40px/44px 590, 15px/24px #8a8f98 lead, h2 20px/26.6px 590 48px lower.

Card grid: four columns of 280px cards, 16px gaps, 20px wider than the text column on each side; rgba(255,255,255,0.05) fill and border, 8px radius; icon top left, text panel at the bottom behind a 1px line with a 15px/510 title and 14px/21px text.
Phones: a 64px bar with logo, Sign up and a 48px burger that opens the sidebar links; cards stack in one column, no site footer.

templates.name: Centered
templates.use: Single-purpose pages built around one centred action: download and brand.
structure: Site header: sticky, 72px plus a 1px #23252a line (64px plus line below 640px), backdrop blur 20px over rgba(8,9,10,0.8); logo left, Product and Resources menus, Customers, Pricing, Now, Contact, a 1px divider, Log in, Sign up pill 32px; a burger replaces the links below 900px.
Hero: 164px app icon 59px below the header, h1 32px/36px 590 30px lower, a 17px/23.8px #d0d6e0 line, a 40px primary pill with a key hint and a 12px #62666d version line.

Ruled blocks in an 832px column: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05) top line, 32px top and 40px bottom padding, a 14px/21px lead on the left and a 360px list of 56px rows on the right (label with a 14px icon, 24px pill actions).
Phones: store buttons stack, the blocks become one column with the list indented 24px.

Footer: 1px top line, logo mark plus five link columns (Product, Features, Company, Resources, Connect) on a 6 x 160px grid, 4 x 150px at 900px, 2 x 155px below 640px; links 13px/400 #8a8f98; legal row at the bottom.

templates.name: Integrations
templates.use: The integration directory: categories with a sticky side list.
structure: Site header: sticky, 72px plus a 1px #23252a line (64px plus line below 640px), backdrop blur 20px over rgba(8,9,10,0.8); logo left, Product and Resources menus, Customers, Pricing, Now, Contact, a 1px divider, Log in, Sign up pill 32px; a burger replaces the links below 900px.
Head in a 1024px column (24px padding): h1 40px/44px 510 57px below the header, a 224 x 40px search pill with a key hint on the right; a 1px #18191a rule 56px lower.
Side list: 316px, sticky at 96px, 44px rows of 16px/24px #8a8f98 with an icon, current #f7f8f8.

Twelve category sections in a 640px column, 810px apart with a 1px #18191a line: 15px/24px 510 title and #8a8f98 text, then a two-column grid of 304 x 168px cards (32px gaps, #0f1011, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05), 12px radius; 40px logo, 15px/510 name, 12px 'By' line with a verified mark, two lines of 14px/23.8px text) and a 15px/510 #828fff 'Browse all' link.
Build block: 580px tall, a 640 x 440px art behind a centred 40px/44px 510 title, 15px/19.95px text and a 40px primary pill.
Phones: no side list or search, one column of 148px cards 16px apart.

Footer: 1px top line, logo mark plus five link columns (Product, Features, Company, Resources, Connect) on a 6 x 160px grid, 4 x 150px at 900px, 2 x 155px below 640px; links 13px/400 #8a8f98; legal row at the bottom.

templates.name: Auth
templates.use: Log in and sign up: a light, centred form with no site chrome.
structure: Light palette (see color.alternate): centred logo and title, a stack of full-width provider buttons, then the email step with one field and a continue button; a small switch link between log in and sign up below.
